articles.title: How a 90s Power Ballad Made the New Lego Batman Trailer Unforgettable
articles.summary: The launch trailer for Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is set entirely to Seal’s “Kiss from a Rose,” and it’s a stroke of marketing genius. The game mashes up 80 years of Batman lore into an open-world brick adventure. It drops May 22.

articles.title: There’s a 218-Mile-Wide Hot Blob Under New England, and It’s Headed for NYC
articles.summary: A massive, unusually hot blob of mantle rock sits 124 miles beneath New England. Scientists say it’s drifting toward New York City at 12 miles per million years, and it may be buoying up the Appalachians.

articles.title: The Grossest Scene in 2026 Gaming Was Designed to Make You Cringe
articles.summary: Mixtape’s first-kiss minigame lets you control two teens’ tongues in excruciating detail. Developers at Beethoven & Dinosaur used particle systems for saliva ropes and had to mute the audio while working on it.
